description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment, Madapatha Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521204
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land parcels (extent, class, particulars, and rights of way/servitude) for various properties in the Colombo District. The content is purely land and property-related, focusing on title registration amendments, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
